newsitem.title: USA: Alliant sees Q4 after-tax gain on unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Alliant sees Q4 after-tax gain on unit sale.

text.p: Alliant Techsystems Inc said Monday it expects to record an after-tax gain of about $20 million in the fourth quarter, which ends March 31, on the $141 million sale of its Marine Systems Group to Hughes Electronics Corp.
Alliant on Monday said it completed the sale of Marine Systems. The transaction was first announced on December 23, 1996.
Richard Schwartz, Alliant chairman, president and chief executive officer, said most of the proceeds will be used to reduce debt.

"Approximately $90 million of the cash generated from the sale will go toward debt repayment, which will lower our debt-to-total capitalization ratio significantly and reduce our interest expense accordingly," Schwartz added in a statment.
He said the balance of the proceeds will go toward the company's share repurchase program or for other strategic initiatives.

After the sale of the Marine Systems Group, Alliant Techsystems has annual revenues of about $1.1 billion, with the company's Aerospace Systems Group accounting for just over half of the total. Other business groups include defense systems and emerging business.
